### Step 1: Understand the equation

We are told:

$$
pqrs + 1 = 4^{p+q}
$$

This suggests that the product of the four smallest primes $ p, q, r, s $ is very small compared to $ 4^{p+q} $.

reflection.new_direction: Rewrite the equation as pqrs = 4^{p+q} - 1 and use modular arithmetic to constrain the primes.
